findings.title: First-review prerequisites omit the Bash required by bundled tests
findings.evidence: Original README.md:23 lists POSIX shell, while tests/test_validators.py:20 explicitly invokes bash. commands.json original-exact-readme-setup-without-bash exits 0 and reproduces bafd0da8…; original-without-bash-tests runs 35 tests with 7 FileNotFoundError bash errors; original-normal-validator-tests runs the same 35 successfully.
findings.counterexample: On an isolated PATH exposing python3, node, sh and mktemp but no bash, the exact original README setup succeeds. The subsequent original validator suite returns exit 1 with seven Bash-launch errors, versus exit 0/35 passing with normal PATH. Expected: first-review prerequisites name the runtime required by the supplied tests. Proposed README.md:27 now explicitly requires Bash; disposition verified.

findings.title: Update comparison labels a locally added file as not a local adaptation
findings.evidence: Original tools/qore.py:278-283 requires baseline membership for local_adaptation. commands.json original-compare-added reports installed-only references/local-policy.md, installed digest e16bddd57b50d85905ab76d2e6e10a9ea781d2f25d3241689c9edb511d8a9d2a, candidate null, local_adaptation=false. Proposed identical probe returns true.
findings.counterexample: Install a fresh verified candidate in a new temporary project, add references/local-policy.md to qore-review, and compare the unchanged candidate. Original returns false although the installed-only file is a local addition; expected true under docs/profiles.md update guidance. Proposed returns true for the same bytes; disposition verified.

findings.title: Release manifest replaces recorded browser-observation origins with first-party
findings.evidence: Original tools/qore.py:58-60 hard-codes first-party. Fresh builds reproduce original bafd0da80667a00f9e6bd2f9e726eaa64d61ff42d026b9f58eb857df15bf40f8 and proposed 211ce7479ee8f3cee66503f4949aae67ba67a8a009e476d4afee4e22c6b01b29. original-origin.json shows 12 same-path/same-digest Qaizen-public-observation rights records emitted as first-party; proposed-origin.json preserves all 12 origins.
findings.counterexample: Build the original public candidate to new temporary staging and compare each non-first-party release-rights.json entry to its generated manifest entry. Twelve origin values change to first-party despite identical resource digests; expected preservation of the explicit digest-bound source origin. Proposed rebuild preserves all twelve and accepts the origin in its release schema/verifier; disposition verified.
